config.name: cqg_n160_capped_vs_t25fig3
config._purpose: EXPLORATORY, not a gate. The capped kernel as it stands (global term + cap of 2 squares per edge, which is the model simulated in [KTB19] Sec. 4) at the published size N = 160 and at the 22 couplings of [T25] Fig. 3, cooled from random and heated from a fresh torus. Parameters were fixed before the run from the published figure alone; run once; everything kept. Sweep counts are our guess, the published ones are not stated.
